cardOverview.overviewText: A Priority card from SCB providing global concierge services, milestone benefits, insurance cover, and lifestyle privileges, tailored for affluent customers.

benefitRows.name: Golf
benefitRows.offer: 2 complimentary golf games per month at select domestic golf courses organized by Golflan Technology Solutions Pvt Ltd.|1 complimentary golf coaching session every month.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Access the designated golf booking portal using the email ID registered with your credit card. Choose your preferred golf course, date, and time, and complete the booking. You’ll receive a confirmation via email, take this with you when you play. Note that additional costs like caddy fees and carts are usually not covered and must be paid at the course.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: Protect yourself with complimentary overseas air accident cover of INR 1 Crore and medical insurance worth USD 25,000.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To claim this insurance, report the incident to Standard Chartered Customer Care at 1860 419 5858 or email customercare@sc.com.
